title: Retire request
description: `{ cards }` or `{ region }`, never both: the cards the person removes from the board, by number, or the container they remove with every card in it now.

cards.description: The cards to remove, by number on this board, each once.

region.description: The container to remove, with every card in it now (the person's moves count), in place of `cards`.

allOf.description: Cards or a container, never both.
